description: This file defines a LoyaltyCardReader class implementing NFC card reading functionality via Android's NFC APIs. It handles detection of NFC tags, communicates with them using ISO-DEP protocol, and extracts account data from NFC cards, specifically for a loyalty card service.

classes.name: LoyaltyCardReader
classes.description: A class that implements NFC tag detection and communication for loyalty card services, handling AID selection, transceiving commands, and callback invocation with account information.

methods.name: onTagDiscovered
methods.description: Handles NFC tag discovery, connects to tag via IsoDep, sends select AID command, and processes response to extract account info.

methods.name: BuildSelectApdu
methods.description: Constructs an APDU command to select a specific AID for NFC card communication.

methods.name: ByteArrayToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: HexStringToByteArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: onTagDiscovered
methods.description: Callback triggered when an NFC tag is detected; communicates with the tag to retrieve account info.

methods.name: BuildSelectApdu
methods.description: Builds an APDU command to select an AID on the NFC card.

methods.name: ByteArrayToHexString
methods.description: Utility for converting byte arrays to hex strings.

methods.name: HexStringToByteArray
methods.description: Utility for converting hex strings to byte arrays.
